member.name: T:FoodDrinkMaui.Services.FoodDataService
member.summary:
Centralised mock data service providing all recipe and restaurant data for the app.
This is the single source of truth — all pages consume data from this service, eliminating the hardcoded duplication that previously existed across XAML and code-behind files.
To add a new food type: add a new entry to and optionally a corresponding to .
